data.long_meaning: A strong and powerful man, one who provides protection and security, derived from the Old Testament name Hammer, and the Old English word ford meaning a shallow place in a river where one can cross easily. The name Hamfurd carries the meaning “Hammer of the ford” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hamfurd usually hope their child will grow to embody hammer of the ford and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamfurd total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hamfurd" combines the powerful and unyielding nature of the Old Testament figure Hammer with the practical and accessible interpretation of "ford," highlighting the idea of a strong individual who offers security and protection to those around them. This name may evoke images of a courageous leader or a brave protector.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Hamfurd" can also be seen as a reminder of God's steadfast and unchanging presence in our lives. Just as the ford in a river provides a reliable and accessible crossing point, so too does God provide a reliable and accessible point of connection and refuge. The name Hamfurd can serve as a constant reminder of the power and strength that comes from God, and the security and protection that comes from placing our faith in Him.
